Engineer proximity-mine resource attribution
============================================

The Engineer mine's first-person and world sprites, throw/bounce/beep sounds,
and core arming concept are adapted from the slot-0 Land Mine in the
user-supplied Doom_Deluxe_Beta1.pk3. TuinRPG provides a standalone actor,
Engineer-only quick-use integration, targeting logic, and its existing grenade
explosion balance/effects; it does not include Doom Deluxe's player framework.

Doom Deluxe team credit: Dox778, Jade, Wocht11K, Machinegun Cow,
Generic Name Guy, TommyGalano5, Squig, and JijaDoubleShotgun (Rick).

The supplied Doom Deluxe credits identify the land-mine sprite sources as
LucasArts, with edits by Gothic, and its sound sources as LucasArts and Quake 2.
